record.label: Find-All bounds and baseline speedups
record.statement: The authors report speedups over the evaluated baselines at every grid pair with $k\ge2$, up to $2.57\times$.
record.boundary: At $m=k=2$, the table bounds the average expected rounds by about $0.66670$ times $(\pi/4)(1+1/\sqrt{2})\sqrt{N/2}$. The authors divide the baseline coefficient by the Lean upper bound relative to the same scale. Figure 3d marks the largest reported speedup of $2.57\times$ at $(1024,512)$. At $(1024,1024)$, the Lean coefficient is smaller, at $0.024207754734$, and the baseline coefficient also differs. The figures round the displayed coefficients and speedups.
